prompt.en: Which of these does Discover Canada list as a Canadian manufactured product?
prompt.fr: Lequel de ces produits Découvrir le Canada présente-t-il comme un produit manufacturé canadien?

explanation.en: Aerospace technology is on the list of manufactured products in Discover Canada, along with paper, high technology equipment, automobiles, machinery, food and clothing.
explanation.fr: La technologie aérospatiale figure dans la liste des produits manufacturés de Découvrir le Canada, avec le papier, le matériel de haute technologie, les automobiles, la machinerie, les aliments et les vêtements.

source.quote: Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food, clothing and many other goods.

verification.evidence: Manufactured products include paper, high technology equipment, aerospace technology, automobiles, machinery, food, clothing and many other goods.
